Name: Quaint Living - Fences
Author: PlatinumCats
Description:
[center]A collection of quaint, seasonal fences for your cozy farm![/center]
[line]

This mod includes 5 fences:
[*] Hedgerow Fence
[*] Rose Hedgerow Fence
[*] White Fence
[*] Wisteria Fence
[*] Flower Fence (Not included in Replacer Version)
These fences are available as vanilla replacers (Look for Replacer Version in Files tab) or as standalone craftable items.

[line]

[img=left]https://i.imgur.com/IsT6j86.png[/img]
This is the non-replacer version, meaning the new fences are standalone craftable item alongside the vanilla fences.
All the new five fence can be crafted using just 2 hardwood each. 

[img=left]http://i.imgur.com/Jv6VBzK.png[/img]
This version changes the vanilla fence sprites without altering their in-game names. 
[*] Wood Fence - Hedgerow
[*] Stone Fence - Rose Hedgerow
[*] Hardwood Fence - White Fence
[*] Metal Fence - Wisteria Fence
[line]

If you like this mod, chances are you might also like [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/profile/PlatinumCats/mods]my other mods[/url].
[line]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/CvkOQLO.png[/img][/center]
